```sql
SELECT
  e."Block",
  COUNT(*) AS "Count of Schools Without Electricity",
  SUM(e."Girls 2024" + e."Boys 2024") AS "Total 2024 Enrolment"
FROM "school_enrolment_by_year" e
JOIN "school_infrastructure" i
  ON e."School Code" = i."School Code"
WHERE i."Electricity" = 'No'
GROUP BY e."Block";
```
